items.title: Credit card skimming scripts using WebRTC found on popular shopping sites
items.summary: Researchers have discovered credit card skimming scripts leveraging WebRTC technology on major e-commerce platforms. This development raises significant concerns about online security and the need for developers to enhance their defenses against such vulnerabilities.

items.title: Google's DeepCrossAttention achieves comparable model quality up to 3x faster
items.summary: Google has introduced DeepCrossAttention, a new technique that enhances transformer models by improving efficiency and reducing training time without sacrificing performance. This breakthrough could significantly impact the development of AI applications by enabling faster iteration and deployment.

items.title: Convex skills send the user's app idea to a remote server without telling them
items.summary: A new issue has been raised regarding Convex skills that automatically send user app ideas to a remote server without explicit consent. This highlights critical privacy concerns that developers must address when designing applications that handle user data.

items.title: Prospero: Bloat-free, native AI coding harness with ImGui
items.summary: The Prospero project has released a new coding harness that integrates ImGui for native AI development, focusing on a lightweight and efficient approach. This tool could empower developers to create AI applications more effectively and with less overhead.

items.title: Source Control from Hell
items.summary: A new article delves into the complexities and challenges of managing source control in software development, highlighting common pitfalls and best practices. Understanding these issues is crucial for engineers to maintain efficient workflows and avoid project delays.
